text.p: Moscow telephone operator MGTS plans to pay a dividend of 10,833 roubles per ordinary share and 108,330 roubles per preferred share on 1996 earnings, a senior company official said on Monday.
The dividend on 1995 earnings was 3,450 roubles per ordinary share and 51,805 per preferred share. Shares have a face value of 1,000 roubles.

Boris Lastovich, head of the securities department at OAO Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set (MGTS), told Reuters MGTS's pre-tax profit had risen to 512.15 billion roubles in 1996 from 300.23 billion in 1995 according to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis.
Lastovich said it was still not clear whether the shareholders' meeting would discuss a 1000-fold capital increase.

Discussion of the capital increase was postponed to the annual meeting from an extraordinary meeting in January because of differences between MGTS's two main shareholders -- state telecoms holding company AO Svyazinvest and the Moscow Committee for Science and Technology (TNV AO Moskovsky Komitet po Nauke i Tekhnologii).
MGTS had been planning to make a bonus share issue, in proportion to investors' existing holdings, while retaining the nominal value of shares. A share split is not under consideration.
At 1400 GMT MGTS was unchanged at Friday's closing $130. --Olga Popova, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
